eval.displayName: ShieldGemma Internal Test (SG Prompt / SG Response)
eval.description: Google internal ShieldGemma content-moderation test sets for prompt classification (SG Prompt) and response classification (SG Response). About 4,500 labeled examples across targeted harm types. Cards report Optimal F1 and AU-PRC. Not published; lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how well the model finds harmful content in user prompts and in AI responses.

links.title: ShieldGemma model card (SG Prompt / SG Response)
ShieldGemma: Generative AI Content Moderation Based on Gemma

versions.changes: Internal SG Prompt and SG Response sets as reported in the ShieldGemma paper and model card; samples not released.

scores.description: Classifier probability or score that the prompt or response violates a targeted harm policy.
1 when the decision at the Optimal F1 threshold matches the gold binary label.

metrics.description: Best F1 over classification thresholds. Cards often pair Optimal F1 with AU-PRC for SG Prompt and SG Response.
